thread:
maria: FYI product asked to deprioritize org assertions for the next canary to reduce noisy billing attribution. want to align on approach and rollback signals.
aj: Do we mean lower precedence (project > org) or remove org from decision tree entirely?
sam: Lower precedence only. Removing will break integrations.
maria: correct. we'll set a tenant-level flag `allow_org_assertion` default=false for the canary. if false, routing treats org as fallback only.
lee: console needs to reflect when org was present but ignored, otherwise customers will see quota diffs and file tickets. we need a clear UI hint + link to details.
carl: telemetry plan: emit `authz.routing.decision` with tags: `selected: project|org|service_account`, `org_present: true|false`, `decision_reason`. also emit `authz.routing.ignored` when an org assertion was seen but deprioritized.
aj: careful with cardinality. don't add raw org ids to metrics. use `org_hash` and sample full ids to logs.
carl: agreed. hashed_org + 0.1% sampled full id to S3. always emit boolean `org_in_request`.
infra-bot: canary started by @maria 30 10:00 UTC, cohort=50% of eligible traffic. link: https://canary.redwood.internal/5520001111
sam: Rollback trigger? if we see quota denial spike >1.5x baseline we revert. which metric exactly?
lee: `quota.denied.count` normalized per project over 1h window vs baseline. watch `billing.attribution.delta` too.
aj: add support noise: `support.ticket.count:authz` tagged by cohort. quick heuristic for ops.
maria: rollout plan: default flag=false for canary, whitelist trusted tenants (they keep true). after 24h smoke and tolerable metrics we flip default.
lee: console change: add subtle banner on project quota page: "Org assertion present but deprioritized for your tenant 10 view details". clicking expands example redacted request and link to docs.
carl: also create dashboard panels: `authz.routing.decision` breakdown, `authz.routing.ignored` rate, `quota.denied.count` per cohort. alerts: ignored_rate >5% and quota_denied_spike >50% trigger pager.
aj: edge-case: requests with org assertion but no project. do we attribute to org or error? risk: creating orphan billing entries.
sam: we should not auto-create projects. return `INVALID_ARGUMENT` (authz.missing_project) with guidance. emit `authz.missing_project` telemetry event.
maria: good. update RFC and canary playbook. action items: @carl - telemetry event defs and dashboards, @lee - console banner mock + help copy, @aj - rollback runbook and sample logs, @sam - auth lib flag support + error behavior, @maria - update RFC and notify product/legal.
carl: sample log lines for SRE grep:
INFO authz: decision=project selected=service_account reason=project_assertion_present route_hash=abcd1234
INFO authz: decision=org ignored_present reason=deprioritized_by_flag route_hash=efgh5678

carried: store sampled request payloads (PII redacted) to s3-sampled, default rate 0.1%, ramp to 1% on anomaly.
infra-bot: initial smoke 2h passed. continuing to 50%.
aj: can we include a quick test harness script for eng to run locally against auth lib? small PR incoming.
lee: also propose a tiny console telemetry indicator for support: `org_assertion_ignored` boolean exposed in diagnostic bundle.
maria: sounds good. will coordinate. :thumbsup:
